reviews.title: Unsafe 5min Radar Delay
reviews.text: I’ve used Hi-Def Radar for years to monitor potential flooding on burn scars and changing mountain conditions because it’s radar was reliable and timely. Lately, however, the free version only displays radar up to 5 min before the current time unless you pay for the service. That delay is unacceptable-and potentially dangerous-during rapidly developing severe weather, especially flash floods and tornados. Timely radar should not be hidden behind a paywall when people may rely on it for their safety. I’ve switched to another app.

reviews.title: Dangerous delays
reviews.text: It’s important to be able to see current weather conditions especially when dangerous conditions exist.  This app shows “now” which is actually 20 minutes ago lag time.  The developer has the ability to show current conditions but chooses not to, which becomes a danger to the users instead of a reliable source of information about current weather conditions.  I updated the app, and now there is a 16 minute delay instead of a 20 minute delay.  So folks can get the important severe weather AFTER it’s already happened.  Do better.  This should not be allowed on the App Store marketplace.

Edit: The developer’s response dodges the issue. I am signed in with the original paid account, my subscription is active, and restoring purchases does not fix this.

The problem is that I received a promotional push notification while the app was closed and my iPhone was locked. The app logs show marketing/promo notification activity, including sys_push_notification_marketing_promo, yet I cannot find any in-app setting to opt out of promotional push notifications while keeping weather alerts enabled.

I have contacted “priority” support multiple times with no real response.

reviews.title: Constantly asking to subscribe and now no radar animation
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for a while, but it’s no longer my go-to radar for two reasons. 

First, every time you open the app, you are greeted with not one, but two, count them two full-screen pop-ups asking you to subscribe to the app. I get that a free app is going to have some shortfalls, but two pop-ups is overkill. On top of that, the subscriptions are way overpriced, and the constant “deals” or “sales” they have going on prove it. 

Second, a recent app update has removed any radar animation from the free version. When I click to animate the past radar image (not future), I’m greeted again with a full-screen pop-up to subscribe. 

At the end of the day, it was an OK radar app to begin with, but the free version is now worthless. Radar, whatever app you choose, needs to be quick and informative due to the nature (pun intended) of the risk you’re trying to avoid (severe weather). But now the free version just doesn’t tick those boxes. If you happen to love it and want to subscribe at the ridiculous prices they charge, your experience might be better.

reviews.title: Incessant Pop-ups
reviews.text:
This app is becoming almost unusable due to the incessant popups. I just counted 3 different ones in a row! The first popup keeps freezing now which almost seems strategic to get us to look at it longer when I am sure they know that most of us just breeze past it. They also have the "X" and "not now" buttons in different locations so you don't develop muscle memory to close out the pop ups. Annoying the heck out of people is NO WAY to get us to upgrade! Nobody is trying to pay monthly for this app anyway!! There are hundreds of different radar apps, and you can look it up free online anyway. I bought this app already back in the day when it only cost $1. You don't get to take back the product that I paid for.

I will delete this app very soon if these popups are not removed.
